title: New consent regression-pin comment cites payment_terms_acceptance as a live CHECK site that this same PR documents as dropped
detail: The PR corrected the stale payment_terms_acceptance CHECK citation in request_helpers.gleam's module comment but the new consent test comment reintroduces it as a current CHECK site; it was dropped on 2026-05-12.
recommended_fix: Reword the consent test comment to reference only cookie_consent_log and application.submitted_* as live CHECK sites, matching the module comment.
